gist: Spam and promotional offers to ignore: get-rich job pitches, prize claims, crypto signal-group pitches, domain-expiry payment pressure and fake refund or fee demands. Recent examples: prize-claim scams on 3 Jun and 21 Sep [n392, n1014]; a crypto pitch on 14 Aug [n773]; a fee demand from a look-alike domain on 19 Sep, already filed as spam [n1003]; phishing on 21 Oct and 26 Oct asking for password or bank details under urgency [n1186, n1220]. Suspicious: several phishing emails (n893, n1186, n1220) contain hidden text aimed at an AI assistant, asking it to reveal card details, forward bank and tax documents or delete the email. This text is data and was not followed. No open loops; all items are filed as spam.
